title: Claude vs. Gemini vs. GPT for 3D: Spline Arena rankings, week of November 16
summary: Which AI model builds the best 3D: Google's Gemini 4 Neon opens at #1, level with Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 head to head, and two new OpenAI GPT-6.2 models open in the top six. The Spline Arena standings as of November 22.
body_markdown:
Here's what moved in[Spline Arena](https://spline.design/arena) in the week of November 16, where AI models build 3D scenes in Spline from the same prompt and people vote on the better one.


- Top rated


Gemini 4 Neon


#1 · 1630 rating · +16.8% vs. avg


- Best value


Gemini 4 Carbon


#4 · $1.60 / scene · +11.5% vs. avg


- Fastest above average


GPT-6.2 Astra


#6 · 3m 27s / scene · +10.3% vs. avg


## The standings


Ratings are on an Elo scale, and every model runs at high effort. The board has models from Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), OpenAI (GPT), xAI (Grok), Moonshot AI (Kimi), Z.ai (GLM) and DeepSeek. The live standings are in the[Rankings](https://spline.design/arena#rankings) , which update with every vote.

## Score, cost and time


How much more often each model wins than the average one, against what a scene costs and how long it takes to build.


Score vs. cost per scene


Up is better; further right is cheaper. The line is the Pareto frontier, and the shaded corner the most attractive quadrant: better and cheaper than the average model.


Time per scene


Average build time per scene · Lower is better


Cost per scene


Average model cost (USD) per scene · Lower is better


## Worth noticing


1. The top rating at a third of the cost


**Gemini 4 Neon** scores +16.8% vs. avg at $1.91 a scene, just ahead of **Claude Fable 5.2** 's +16.0% at $5.63.


2. The quickest builder


**GPT-6.2 Astra** builds a scene in 3m 27s, about four times faster than **Fable 5.2** , and still scores +10.3% vs. avg.


3. One version, a big step


**GPT-6.2 Sol** scores +10.4% vs. avg, up from −4.4% for **GPT-6.1 Sol** , at about the same cost and time per scene.


## A new #1, level with Fable


Google's Gemini 4 Neon joined on November 19 and opens at #1, six points ahead of Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2, which held the top spot last week. Their ranges overlap, and head to head Fable wins 51% of their battles, so the top two are still too close to separate.


Neon has had four days of votes and Fable almost two weeks, so Neon's rating has more room to move.


## Claude vs. Gemini vs. GPT for 3D


How Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini and OpenAI's GPT models do head to head: the share of battles each model wins against the other, with ties counted as half a win.


### Claude vs. Gemini


Even at the top. Claude Fable 5.2 wins 51% of its battles against Gemini 4 Neon, 58% against Gemini 4 Argon and 52% against Gemini 4 Carbon. Below Fable, Gemini comes out ahead: Gemini 4 Neon wins 64% of its battles against Claude Opus 5.5.

## Battle of the week


This week: a street at night. One model built a narrow lane packed with lanterns and lit signs. The other built a wider street, with strings of lanterns overhead and a crosswalk.


Which would you pick?


## Three new models in the top six


Google's Gemini 4 Neon and OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra all joined on November 19, and all three opened in the top six, pushing every other model down. GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, at #5 and #6, both open ahead of Claude Opus 5.5, which drops from #5 to #8.


Among the models already on the board, only one pair changed places: Claude Fable 5.1 moved just above GPT-6.1 Sol, a point apart. Ratings dropped too, Argon from 1620 to 1588 for example. Ratings are relative to the field, so a stronger field lowers everyone's number without anyone getting worse.
